# 01 Warmup

Implement the two functions in `solution.py`:

- `count_vowels(text)` returns how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u, any case) `text` contains.
- `most_common_word(text)` returns the most frequent whitespace-separated word, ignoring case. On a tie, return the word that appears first. Return `None` for empty text.

Run the tests locally with `pytest assignments/01-warmup/tests`.
